input.prompt: The camera itself is completely locked off and motionless like a tripod photograph, with absolutely no zoom, no push-in, no drift, no pan and no camera movement of any kind for the entire clip. Everything else, including the wall, the sofa, the plant on the left and especially the framed poster, is completely still and motionless. Bright, warm, cozy early-autumn Friday evening, interior magazine photography quality.
